name: StarRating
description: A star rating input that previews the score as you hover (down to half stars), springs the hovered star up, and pops the stars in sequence when a rating is committed. Works with arrow keys and has a read-only display mode.
a11yNotes: Interactive mode is a single focusable role="slider" (aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax = count, aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext like "3.5 out of 5 stars, Good") labelled by the visible caption. ArrowRight/ArrowUp and ArrowLeft/ArrowDown change by one step (0.5 with allowHalf), PageUp/PageDown by a whole star, Home/End jump to 0/max and number keys set whole ratings. Read-only mode renders role="img" with an aria-label stating the rating. Individual stars are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the hover lift and pop are disabled.

propsApi.name: defaultValue
propsApi.description: Initial rating when uncontrolled (snapped to the step and clamped to count).

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the newly committed rating.

propsApi.name: allowHalf
propsApi.description: Allow half-star ratings (left half of a star = .5).

propsApi.name: readOnly
propsApi.description: Display-only mode exposed as an image with a descriptive label.

propsApi.name: allowClear
propsApi.description: Clicking the current rating again resets it to 0.

propsApi.name: activeColor
propsApi.description: Fill and glow color of active stars.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Accessible name, shown as a caption when showLabel is true.

propsApi.name: showLabel
propsApi.description: Show the label above the stars.

propsApi.name: showValue
propsApi.description: Show the numeric value (and a word like 'Good' for 5-star scales).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
